description.en: Read camera manufacturer, model, sensor, serial number and version.
description.zh: 读取相机制造商、型号、传感器、序列号和版本信息。

description.en: Camera capabilities including format, read mode, trigger mode, lane capabilities and resolution/framerate limits.
description.zh: 相机能力集，包括格式、读取模式、触发模式、Lane 能力及分辨率/帧率范围。

description.en: Resolution and framerate configuration including ROI and frame rate settings.
description.zh: 分辨率和帧率配置，包括 ROI 和帧率设置。

description.en: Read current camera status including resolution, frame rate, exposure, gain, temperature, etc.
description.zh: 读取相机当前状态，包括分辨率、帧率、曝光、增益、温度等。

description.en: Configure exposure mode, gain mode, AE target, manual exposure time, gain, exposure time range and related parameters.
description.zh: 配置曝光模式、增益模式、AE 目标、手动曝光时间、增益、曝光时间范围及相关参数。

description.en: Configure ISP parameters: gamma, gamma enable, DPC enable, BLC mode, black level, etc.
description.zh: 配置 ISP 参数：Gamma、Gamma 使能、DPC 使能、BLC 模式、黑电平等。

description.en: Configure trigger mode, source, number, interval, delay, filter, edge, software trigger and synchronization.
description.zh: 配置触发模式、触发源、触发帧数、间隔、延迟、滤波、边沿、软件触发和同步。

description.en: Configure GPIO output mode, user output, signal reversal and read GPIO status.
description.zh: 配置 GPIO 输出模式、用户输出、信号反转及读取 GPIO 状态。

description.en: Configure pixel format, image direction, test image, MIPI clock mode, OSD mode, etc.
description.zh: 配置像素格式、图像方向、测试图像、MIPI 时钟模式、OSD 模式等。

description.en: System-level operations: factory reset, save to flash, reboot, I2C address change, image acquisition, MCU bypass.
description.zh: 系统级操作：恢复出厂设置、保存到 Flash、重启、修改 I2C 地址、采集控制、MCU 旁路。

description.en: Advanced debug operations: sensor register indirect read.
description.zh: 高级调试操作：传感器寄存器间接读取。
